response.text: You're in your second loading wave, about two weeks out from a deload, so today's main lift sits at a submaximal training max — heavy enough to build strength but light enough to keep fatigue in check before the back-off week. The accessories fill what the squat leaves: the carry is low-fatigue grip and trunk durability, and the curl adds direct biceps volume because you set biceps as a focus and your pulls under-train it. Your legs read fresh after yesterday's rest, which is why today leans into the squat pattern rather than backing it off.
